By imposing top-down federal barcodes rather than partnering with states, the administration replaces transparent cooperation with unilateral friction and control.

Elections belong to the people, not bureaucratic hurdles. When voting systems face chaotic eleventh-hour changes, trust in our shared democracy frays at the edges.

Brothekanon:
